title: 第21章 夏凝冰天命对比系统第22章 失败者的惩罚游戏
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
【混沌阴阳诀：夺天地之造化，窃阴阳之玄机。】
【分为阳诀和阴诀两部，既可单独修炼，亦可双修。可通过吸收阴阳之力进阶，当前等级为仙一品】
【注：混沌系功法可辅助觉醒混沌神体】
混沌阴阳决！
仙品功法！
墨羽震惊。
要知道，整个下界，都没有真正的仙品功法存在。
系统居然直接给了！
同时，他有些哭笑不得。
系统你要是想送我东西可以直说，不用找理由的。
还好他和师姐们的关系都还不错。
先不说有系统可以拿奖励。
就算没系统，傍上这几个大腿，也能衣食无忧。
“可有麻烦？”
夏凝冰清冷声音响起，打断了墨羽思绪。
墨羽回过神来，将系统奖励暂且搁置一旁。
他深吸一口气，平复心绪，开始向夏凝冰讲述近日发生之事。
刻意隐去了许多无关紧要的细节，比如和凌清月的事，在墨家发生的事。
然后说明了一下后期目标，找机会去灭了那个秦家。
“嗯。”

夏凝冰静静地听完墨羽汇报，轻轻应了一声，便不再有任何动静。
“弟弟，姐姐去帮你灭那个秦家。”
一道慵懒妩媚的声音突然响起，打破了沉默。
紧接着，一道白光闪过，白狐形态的苏媚儿已然出现在墨羽怀中。
“谢谢媚儿姐。”
墨羽轻轻抚摸着苏媚儿柔顺的白毛。
苏媚儿似乎很享受墨羽抚摸，她微微眯起眼睛，发出满足的低吟。
然后，她的小脑袋在墨羽怀里蹭了蹭，找了个舒服的姿势，沉沉睡去。
墨羽重新看向夏凝冰。
“师姐，我最近碰到太清圣女凌清月，她说与我有婚约，师姐知道是怎么回事吗？”
夏凝冰素手轻挥，几张纸轻飘飘地飞向墨羽手中。
“师尊留的，自己看。”
墨羽接过，垂眸扫了一眼。
第一张，是叶汐湄留下的信。
字迹龙飞凤舞，透着一股子不羁。
大致意思是，近年她与人赌博，帮他“赢”了包括美女在内的不少好东西，甚至一时兴起，还把他当成了赌注……
墨羽额角青筋跳动。
content_en:
[Chaos Yin and Yang Jue: Seizing the creation of heaven and earth, stealing the mystery of Yin and Yang. 】
[It is divided into two parts, Yang Jue and Yin Jue, which can be practiced alone or in combination. It can be advanced by absorbing the power of yin and yang. The current level is Immortal Grade 1]
[Note: Chaos exercises can assist in awakening the Chaos Divine Body]
Chaos Yin Yang Jue!
Immortal skills!
Mo Yu was shocked.
You must know that there are no real immortal skills in the entire lower world.
The system actually gave it directly!
At the same time, he was a little dumbfounded.
If you want to send me something to the system, you can just say so without giving me a reason.
Fortunately, he has a good relationship with his senior sisters.
Not to mention there is a system to get rewards.
Even if you don't have a system, you can still have enough food and clothing with these thighs.
"Is there any trouble?"
Xia Ningbing's cold voice sounded, interrupting Mo Yu's thoughts.
Mo Yu came to his senses and put the system rewards aside for the time being.
He took a deep breath, calmed down, and began to tell Xia Ningbing what happened recently.
Many irrelevant details were deliberately hidden, such as what happened with Ling Qingyue and what happened in the Mo family.
Then he explained his later goal and looked for an opportunity to destroy the Qin family.
"Yeah."
Xia Ningbing listened to Mo Yu's report quietly, responded softly, and then there was no more movement.
"Brother, sister, go help you destroy the Qin family."
A lazy and charming voice suddenly sounded, breaking the silence.
Immediately afterwards, a white light flashed, and Su Meier in the form of a white fox appeared in Mo Yu's arms.
"Thank you, Sister Mei'er."
Mo Yu gently stroked Su Meier's soft white hair.
Su Meier seemed to enjoy Mo Yu's touch. She narrowed her eyes slightly and let out a low moan of satisfaction.
Then, she rubbed her little head in Mo Yu's arms, found a comfortable position, and fell asleep.
Mo Yu looked at Xia Ningbing again.
"Senior sister, I recently met Taiqing Saint Ling Qingyue. She said she had a marriage contract with me. Does senior sister know what's going on?"
Xia Ningbingsu waved her hand lightly, and several pieces of paper flew lightly into Mo Yu's hand.
"Master left it for you to look at."
Mo Yu took it and glanced down at it.
The first one is the letter left by Ye Ximei.
The handwriting is flying and phoenix dancing, showing a sense of unruliness.
The general meaning is that in recent years, she has gambled with others and helped him "win" many good things, including beauties, and even used him as a bet on a whim...
The veins on Mo Yu's forehead throbbed.
